orgDesign.companyProfile: European transportation-software company modeled on Alpega Group: enterprise SaaS for shippers (TMS, procurement, execution, visibility, dock scheduling) combined with pan-European freight exchanges (Teleroute, Wtransnet, Bursa Transport style) connecting 80,000+ carriers across 80 countries. Revenue comes from software subscriptions, network memberships, transaction services, and data products — the platform never moves freight itself.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Stream-aligned teams own the shipper lifecycle (Plan, Procure, Execute, Track, Settle, Analyse) and the carrier-network marketplace outcomes; a complicated-subsystem team guards network trust (vetting, fraud, payment guarantees); platform teams provide connectivity, integration, master data, identity, notifications, and billing as internal services reused by every product line. Teams are cross-functional, sized 7-12 FTE, with small group-direct leadership layers.

teams.name: Network Trust

teams.mission: Make the network safe enough that an owner-operator books a stranger's load without fear: every member vetted, fraudsters detected before they transact, and payment losses absorbed by guarantees instead of small carriers.
